text.value: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube are free, and your audience is on them every day. We use your profiles there to send those people to your website, the one place online you own and the one place they can buy from you or book a call. Most coaches, authors and influencers put something out when they get a spare minute, and it dries up the week a launch gets busy. We turn ten minutes of you talking into a month of videos, clips and captions in your own words. You approve them on your phone, they publish on schedule, and every one points home.

props.intro: Automated Organic Content Engine is one of six systems we build. They are designed to connect, so nobody who raises a hand gets dropped between them.

props.text: Ten minutes of talking becomes a month of content.

You speak into your phone once. We cut it into short videos, written pieces and captions in your own words, line them up for you to approve with one tap, and publish them all month. Not ideas for you to write. Finished pieces.

text.label: Text: How it works
text.value: How it works

text.label: Heading: You own the accounts and the words. Ever
text.value: You own the accounts and the words. Every clip points back to your website.

text.label: Text: The social accounts are yours and stay y
text.value: The social accounts are yours and stay yours, and so is the website every clip points to. The face on camera is yours and the words are yours. We do not invent opinions for you or put a stranger's voice on your name. What we add is the part nobody has time for: turning one recording into a month of pieces, writing the captions and titles in the words your audience actually types, and getting them out on a schedule. If we ever part ways, the accounts, the website and everything we made stay with you.

text.label: Text: It also means we report on what your vid
text.value: It also means we report on what your videos sent to your website and what that turned into, not on how many people liked a clip. Attention pointed at a page that cannot catch it just wastes the attention, so if the site is slow or the follow-up is not answering, you will hear that from us before you spend another month recording.

props.text: What lands in front of you every month.
No promises about going viral, and no homework. You talk for ten minutes. This is what comes back, every month, without you chasing anybody for it.

props.body: You sit down once and talk about what you teach. What comes back is the whole month: short videos, written pieces, captions, in your voice, not a stranger's.
props.heading: One recording, a month of clips

props.body: The words are the ones you said. We cut them and caption them; we do not invent opinions for you or hand your name a stranger's voice.
props.heading: Your voice, not a template

props.body: Not to a profile somebody else controls. The place people land is the one page where they can buy from you or book a call.
props.heading: Every piece points to your website

props.text: Most coaches, authors and influencers know they should be putting more out, and never get past the part where somebody has to make the thing. That part is now somebody else's job. Yours is ten minutes and a yes.
Why this one is number six.

Ads and content are the two things that send people to you. Everything before them (the website, answering in seconds, the testimonials, your old list) is what catches people when they arrive. Send a crowd at a page that cannot catch them and you have paid to show more people the weak spot. So we fix the catching first, then we turn on the sending.
